conventions: register via server.registerTool(name, { description, inputSchema }, handler) inside buildMcpServer() in src/server.ts
all list tools spread ...odataShape and implement the $fetchAll branch via client.getAllPages + FETCH_ALL_CAP
list handlers return toListToolText(data, $skip ?? 0); get handlers return toToolText
every handler parses the raw response with a Zod schema before returning
single-record GET endpoints return the same ApiResponse envelope as lists — parse with the list schema
entity summary schemas: only confirmed fields, never the full swagger schema
all handlers use try/catch and return toToolError on failure
imports use the @/ path alias, never relative paths
tool descriptions: plain analyst language; no $filter/$orderby/$top/$skip/OData/eq/PK — enforced by tests/server.test.ts
every new domain gets a DATASETS entry in src/shared/datasets.ts
